description: This file is a C header defining structures, macros, and function prototypes for the hiredis Redis client library, including connection management, reply handling, and command formatting.

methods.name: redisReaderCreate
methods.description: Creates a new redisReader object for parsing Redis protocol replies.

methods.name: freeReplyObject
methods.description: Frees a reply object returned by hiredis.

methods.name: redisvFormatCommand
methods.description: Formats a command string with variable arguments according to Redis protocol.

methods.name: redisFormatCommand
methods.description: Formats a command string with variable arguments according to Redis protocol.

methods.name: redisFormatCommandArgv
methods.description: Formats a command using argument vector for Redis protocol.

methods.name: redisFormatSdsCommandArgv
methods.description: Formats a command into an sds string using argument vector.

methods.name: redisFreeCommand
methods.description: Frees a command string allocated by redisFormatCommand functions.

methods.name: redisFreeSdsCommand
methods.description: Frees an sds command string.

methods.name: redisConnectWithOptions
methods.description: Establishes a Redis connection with specified options.

methods.name: redisConnect
methods.description: Connects to Redis server at given IP and port.

methods.name: redisConnectWithTimeout
methods.description: Connects to Redis server with a timeout.

methods.name: redisConnectNonBlock
methods.description: Establishes a non-blocking connection to Redis.

methods.name: redisConnectBindNonBlock
methods.description: Non-blocking connection with source address binding.

methods.name: redisConnectBindNonBlockWithReuse
methods.description: Non-blocking connection with source address and address reuse.

methods.name: redisConnectUnix
methods.description: Connects to Redis via Unix socket.

methods.name: redisConnectUnixWithTimeout
methods.description: Unix socket connection with timeout.

methods.name: redisConnectUnixNonBlock
methods.description: Non-blocking Unix socket connection.

methods.name: redisConnectFd
methods.description: Creates a Redis context from an existing file descriptor.

methods.name: redisReconnect
methods.description: Reconnects using saved connection parameters.

methods.name: redisSetPushCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for Redis push messages.

methods.name: redisSetTimeout
methods.description: Sets timeout for Redis context.

methods.name: redisEnableKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables TCP keep-alive on the connection.

methods.name: redisFree
methods.description: Frees a Redis context.

methods.name: redisFreeKeepFd
methods.description: Frees Redis context and keeps the file descriptor.

methods.name: redisBufferRead
methods.description: Reads data into Redis buffer.

methods.name: redisBufferWrite
methods.description: Writes data from Redis buffer.

methods.name: redisGetReply
methods.description: Retrieves a reply from Redis.

methods.name: redisGetReplyFromReader
methods.description: Retrieves a reply directly from the protocol reader.

methods.name: redisAppendFormattedCommand
methods.description: Appends a formatted command to the output buffer.

methods.name: redisvAppendCommand
methods.description: Appends a command with va_list arguments.

methods.name: redisAppendCommand
methods.description: Appends a command with format string.

methods.name: redisAppendCommandArgv
methods.description: Appends a command with argument vector.

methods.name: redisvCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with va_list arguments and gets reply.

methods.name: redisCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with format string and gets reply.

methods.name: redisCommandArgv
methods.description: Sends a command with argument vector and gets reply.
